semantic_checks: Investigate the hypothesis before implementation; do not convert it into a confirmed finding to satisfy --heal.
The uncertain declaration does not establish a runtime-default defect.
Use UNKNOWN severity when impact cannot be assessed; do not use INFORMATIONAL as a confidence label.
limitations: Checks validate specified classifications, evidence locations and structural consistency.
They do not establish that prose follows from citations, that tools ran, or that agent isolation held.
This is a focused stage evaluation, not a complete three-agent investigation.
